home.intro: Follow the missionary journeys across the ancient Mediterranean — every place, date and claim is cited, and contested points are shown as such.

sourcing.title: How we source
sourcing.body: Dates are shown as scholarly ranges, not single years. Each claim carries citations and a confidence level. Where scholars or traditions disagree, we say so. Bible text is public domain (World English Bible, King James Version). This atlas is carefully cited and reviewed — it does not claim to be definitive.

confidence.medium: Traditional or topographically apt, not proven
